senses.gloss:
इह ind. [इदं-ह इशादेशः
P. V. 3. 11 Sk.]
1 Here (referring
to time, place or direction); in this
place or case.
--2 In this world
(opp. परत्र or अमुत्र); oft. with जगति;
K. 35.
--3 In this case; in this book
[]
or system.
--4 Now, at this time.
[cf. Zend idha].
--Comp.
--अमुत्र
ind. in this world and the next
world, here and there.
--आगत a.
come here.
--इह ind. here and there,
now and then, repeatedly. ˚मातृ
a. {1} whose mother is here and
there; that is, everywhere. {2}
of whose mothers one is here
and one there.
--कालः this life.
--क्रतु, --चित्त a. whose intentions
or thoughts are centred in this world
or place.
--भव or
--तन a.
belonging to this world.
--लोकः this world
or life; ˚के in this world.
--समये ind.
here, now, at such a time as this.
--स्थ a. standing here.
--स्थान a.
one whose residence is on the earth.

ईहा [ईह्-अ]
1 Wish, desire;
जलनिधिमकरोत्तरीतुमीहां Rām.; see अनीह
also.
--2 An undertaking, act.
--3
Effort, exertion, activity;
ईहातश्चेद्धनं भवेत् Ms. 9. 205.
--Comp.
--अर्थिन्
a. aiming at any object, seeking
wealth; Ms. 2. 37.
--मृगः [ईहाप्रधानो
मृगः] {1} a wolf. {2} an artificial deer. {3}
a division of the drama consisting
of four acts; for definition &c. see
S. D. 518 = वृकः a wolf.

इहत्य a. [इह-त्यप्] Being here, of
this place or world.
